b8052c855b740f437aa92bbd465dafcfc34cfc37: Barèges offers 100 km of well-marked runs — a mid-sized ski area ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. The 28 lifts are generally sufficient to handle the flow in peak season. Barèges' family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Pyrenees for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2500 m and a village at 1250 m, Barèges' snow reliability is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause strains early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly once the first substantial snowfalls arrive. A stay in Barèges is clearly expensive: €53 for a day lift pass, on top of mountain accommodation and restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. That is the price of excellence — but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Barèges is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincere family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to get your stay wrong here.
